implementation.source_contract: index_monthly one unpaged request per provider code and bounded interval; exact 55-code Python monthly universe
implementation.write_strategy: whole-target outside-window copy to YEAR/WAL/DEDUP=false stage; exact full snapshot verification; journaled target-to-backup and stage-to-target rename
implementation.dataset_publication_lock: OS lock held from stage clone through full outside/readback verification and publication across every code and date window
implementation.incremental: same logical target and code receipt-backed contiguous checkpoint; re-fetch two prior months, clamped to frozen anchor
implementation.backfill_reconcile_checkpoint: verified receipts may overlay later physical validation; do not advance incremental checkpoint
implementation.omission_policy: Existing natural keys omitted by a complete source window fail closed before stage creation
implementation.stage_only_recovery: A single durable READY intent binds the frozen request fingerprint, FETCHED raw-source receipt, target generation/full pre-snapshot, exact stage generation and preserved outside rows; under the dataset OS lock recovery publishes only after full stage equality with outside rows plus the reopened source window; normal planning/publication blocks orphan intents from other runs
implementation.direct_write_policy: IndexMonthlyWritePort refuses writes unless bound to a distinct frozen stage with the full-snapshot publication callback

source.count_scope: Twelve primary runs only; recovery, backfill, empty and failed attempts are separate linked evidence.

write.strategy: Full target outside-window copy plus verified DEDUP=false stage, dataset-wide OS lock, journaled rename publication
